letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. Your laugh is my favorite soundtrack, and your smile lights up even the hottest desert nights. I love how we dance between skyscrapers and spice markets, hand‑in‑hand, dreaming of the future we’re building together. Thank you for being my forever cutie, my confidante, and the love that makes every day feel like a gentle summer evening.
poem:
In sunrise gold or monsoon’s sigh,  
Your love’s the star that paints the sky.  
From dunes to rivers, hearts entwine,  
Forever yours, forever mine.
